title: Network Engineering Specifications
content: Path MTU Discovery specification is formally defined in RFC-4821. It specifies probe-based techniques to determine the maximum transmission unit size over an IP path.

title: Network Engineering Specifications

title: Network Engineering Specifications
content: General MTU configuration guidelines recommend setting jumbo frames to 9000 bytes on storage area networks while keeping WAN interfaces at standard 1500 bytes.

title: Site Reliability Engineering Runbook
